# Papers Evaluating PD-1/PD-L1 Immune Checkpoint Blockade

Based on the passages provided, the following corpus papers evaluate PD-1 or PD-L1 immune checkpoint blockade in patients:

- **(PMID:29033130)** - Discusses PD-1 pathway blockade, anti-PD-1 antibody safety and activity, and immune correlates in cancer patients

- **(PMID:32015526)** - References phase I studies of anti-PD-1 therapy and associations with tumor mutational burden and response rates

- **(PMID:29301960)** - Evaluates atezolizumab (anti-PD-L1) in metastatic urothelial carcinoma patients treated with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors

- **(PMID:30150660)** - Examines PD-1 blockade response in multiple cancer types including melanoma, lung, and genitourinary cancers; discusses nivolumab and pembrolizumab

- **(PMID:30742119)** - References nivolumab and pembrolizumab trials for melanoma and non-small-cell lung cancer

- **(PMID:29657128)** - Discusses anti-PD-1 and anti-PD-L1 checkpoint blockade in melanoma and other cancer patients

- **(PMID:30643254)** - Evaluates predictive biomarkers for PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor response across multiple cancer types

- **(PMID:25765070)** - Reports on pembrolizumab (anti-PD-1) treatment in non-small cell lung cancer patients

- **(PMID:26997480)** - Analyzes genomic and transcriptomic features of anti-PD-1 therapy response in metastatic melanoma
